tasks.name: Design Problem Library UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for browsing and searching problems in the library.

tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to fetch and manage problems in the library.

tasks.name: Set Up Problem Database
tasks.description: Create and configure the database schema for storing problem details.

tasks.name: Develop Code Submission UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for users to submit their code solutions.

tasks.name: Implement Code Evaluation Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to evaluate submitted code and return results.

tasks.name: Set Up Code Evaluation Infrastructure
tasks.description: Configure the infrastructure to securely execute and evaluate user-submitted code.

tasks.name: Design User Profile UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for user profiles, including stats and achievements.

tasks.name: Implement User Profile Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to manage user profiles and related data.

tasks.name: Design Leaderboard UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for displaying the leaderboard.

tasks.name: Implement Leaderboard Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to calculate and display leaderboard rankings.

tasks.name: Add Hints and Explanations UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface to display hints and explanations for problems.

tasks.name: Implement Hints and Explanations Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to manage and serve hints and explanations.

tasks.name: Test Problem Library Functionality
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the problem library works as expected.

tasks.name: Test Code Submission and Evaluation
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure code submission and evaluation works correctly.

tasks.name: Test User Profiles
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure user profiles are displayed and updated correctly.

tasks.name: Test Leaderboard Functionality
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the leaderboard displays accurate rankings.

tasks.name: Test Hints and Explanations
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure hints and explanations are displayed correctly.

T1.implementation_approach: Create a user-friendly interface with search, filter, and sorting options for problems.
T1.notes: Ensure responsive design for various devices.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to handle problem data retrieval, creation, and updates.

T3.implementation_approach: Set up a relational database to store problem details, tags, and metadata.

T4.implementation_approach: Design an intuitive UI for users to submit code and view results.
T4.notes: Include error handling and clear feedback messages.

T5.implementation_approach: Build a backend service to compile, execute, and evaluate submitted code.

T6.implementation_approach: Set up infrastructure to handle code execution using containers or virtual machines.

T7.implementation_approach: Design a profile page displaying user details, achievements, and activity history.

T8.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage user data and profile updates.
T8.notes: Ensure data privacy and secure authentication.

T9.implementation_approach: Create a visually appealing leaderboard UI with sorting and filtering options.
T9.notes: Highlight top performers and recent activity.

T10.implementation_approach: Implement backend logic to calculate and update leaderboard rankings.

T11.implementation_approach: Design a UI to display hints and explanations for problems.
T11.notes: Ensure hints are accessible without revealing full solutions.

T12.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage hints and explanations for problems.
T12.notes: Allow for easy updates and versioning.

T13.implementation_approach: Test the problem library UI and backend for functionality and performance.
T13.notes: Include edge cases and stress testing.

T14.implementation_approach: Test code submission and evaluation workflows for accuracy and security.

T15.implementation_approach: Verify user profile features, including data updates and display accuracy.
T15.notes: Test with different user roles and permissions.

T16.implementation_approach: Test leaderboard functionality for correct ranking and real-time updates.
T16.notes: Check for performance under high user load.

T17.implementation_approach: Validate hints and explanations UI and backend for usability and correctness.
